name: poly-velhook
description: Real-velocity capture helper. Hooks the note-on add-to-held-list routine at 0x0801F1E8 (event r1: note=r1+4, velocity=r1+5), stashes body velocity into vel_by_note[note] at CCM 0x1000FD00, then reproduces the two original ldrb and returns to 0x0801F1EC. The capture cave (poly-record) reads vel_by_note[note] so chord notes carry their real velocity (falls back to 100 when unset).

patches.note: note-on add -> stash velocity by note
